SELECT r.id,r.tenant_key,r.company_id,r.sample_order_id,r.review_date,r.result,r.opinion,r.create_by,r.create_time,r.update_by,r.update_time FROM dev_sample_review r JOIN dev_sample_order o ON o.tenant_key=r.tenant_key AND o.company_id=r.company_id AND o.id=r.sample_order_id JOIN dev_sample s ON s.tenant_key=o.tenant_key AND s.company_id=o.company_id AND s.id=o.sample_id AND s.deleted_token=0 JOIN LATERAL(SELECT maker_id FROM dev_sample_order x WHERE x.tenant_key=s.tenant_key AND x.company_id=s.company_id AND x.sample_id=s.id ORDER BY sample_version DESC LIMIT 1) latest ON true WHERE r.tenant_key=#{tenant} AND r.company_id=#{companyId}
AND r.id IN #{id} AND false AND (s.create_by=#{scope.userId} OR s.designer_id=#{scope.userId} OR latest.maker_id=#{scope.userId}) ORDER BY r.id LIMIT 101
